## Key Vocabulary


::: {.vocab-box}
**Restriction enzyme** — A protein that cuts DNA at specific sequences
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**DNA ligase** — An enzyme that glues DNA fragments together
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Plasmid** — A small circular piece of DNA found in bacteria
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Gene cloning** — Making multiple identical copies of a gene
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**PCR** — Polymerase Chain Reaction - a technique to amplify DNA
:::

::: {.vocab-box}
**Recombinant DNA** — DNA from two different sources joined together
:::
